INSTITUTE       FACULTY OF SCIENCE
PROGRAM       MASTER OF SCIENCE (CHEMISTRY)
SEMESTER         1
COURSE TITLE    ANALYTICAL CHEMISTRY-I
COURSE CODE     02CY0410
COURSE CREDITS  4

Objective:
 1  To understand the scope and principle of Analytical Chemistry and various
     electroanalytical methods including radio scattering methods. The emphasis is placed on
     physico-chemical principles of these methods and their application in chemical analysis.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  To develop an understanding of the range and theories of instrumental methods available in
     analytical chemistry.
 2  To develop knowledge pertaining to the appropriate selection of instruments for the
     successful analysis of complex mixtures.
 3  To develop an understanding of the role of the chemist in measurement and problem
     solving in chemical analysis.
 4  To extend skills in procedures and instrumental methods applied in analytical tasks.


Pre-requisite of course:Before learning analytical chemistry, student should aware about basic
principles and theories of analytical chemistry, instrumental methods of analysis and other UG
level chemistry.

                        Teaching and Examination Scheme
 Theory      Tutorial      Practical   ESE    IA    CSE     Viva     Term
  Hours      Hours       Hours                               Work
     4            0            0        50     30      20        0          0
